entities.name: Kim Yong-kang
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Kim Yong-kang is a South Korean former professional boxer who competed from 1985 to 1995. He is a two-time flyweight champion, having held the WBC and The Ring titles from 1988 to 1989 and the WBA title from 1991 to 1992.
